plugins.name: memecoin-kill-relay
plugins.description: Kill-first memecoin screening relay from 0xNevsky's 13-line prompt: five stages (SCOUT, FILTER, ANALYST, EXECUTOR, RISK) pass each candidate down the chain and any single veto kills the coin. Analysis and vetting only; no trade is executed without explicit human approval. Not verified or personally tested; created based on an X.com post.

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: 迷因币一票否决流水线

description_i18n.zh-CN: 来自 0xNevsky 13 行提示词的「先杀后买」迷因币筛查流水线：SCOUT、FILTER、ANALYST、EXECUTOR、RISK 五段接力，任一环节否决即判死。仅做分析与审查，未经人工明确批准不执行交易。基于 X.com 帖子创建，未经作者验证或实测。
